component.name: Wake on LAN for Linux
component.summary: Wake and manage computers on your local network
Sveglia e gestisci i computer della rete locale

description.p: Wake on LAN for Linux provides a modern GTK interface for managing computers, discovering devices on the local network, checking their status, and sending Wake-on-LAN magic packets.

component.developer_name: Wake on LAN for Linux contributors

description.p: First packaged release with network discovery, device groups, status refresh, configurable appearance, portable backups, and Wake-on-LAN support.
